note: The goal tracker in the upper right of the screen (creator, 30 Oct 2026). One short current objective, in story order. scripts/ui/guidance_hud.gd shows the first goal after the last one whose done_on event has fired, so a player who skips ahead is never shown a goal behind them. The text is plain instructions in Ted's and the game's voice; edit freely, keep it to one short line. Never shows time: the ship deadline stays hidden.
heading: GOAL

goals.text: Go down to the engine room
Look for the rowboat at the island dock
Open the island gate for the sailors
Wait for the sailors to come up to the lighthouse
Go up to the lamp room with Ted
Help Ted open up the arc lamp
Go to the launch at the island dock
Board the launch and cast off
Steer across the Gullwater to the Saltgate
Fetch the spare burner from the Saltgate
Get back aboard and cast off
Steer the launch home, clear of the rocks
Take the burner up to the lamp room
Fit the burner into the arc lamp
Stand back and watch the light
